threats.title: [F-023] Zip Slip path traversal during archive extraction — routes/fileUpload.ts:34
threats.description:
An unauthenticated attacker uploads a .zip to POST /file-upload whose entry names contain ../ segments. The containment check only tests that the resolved path contains the working directory, so traversal inside the app root passes and the entry is written outside uploads/complaints, overwriting files such as ftp/legal.md or application assets.

Impact: Arbitrary file overwrite inside the application directory, enabling content tampering and potentially code replacement.

Risk: High (likelihood High, impact High)
CWE: CWE-22
Evidence tier: confirmed-exploitable
Source: stride

Evidence:
createWriteStream uses the raw entry name; the includes(path.resolve('.')) check at line 33 accepts any path under the cwd.
- routes/fileUpload.ts:34

1. Resolve each entry against a fixed base directory and reject entries whose relative path starts with .. or is absolute; write to the resolved path.
2. Add a test uploading a zip with ../ entries and assert it is rejected.
Verification: Upload a zip containing ../../ftp/legal.md and confirm no file outside uploads/complaints changes.
